summary: Feed c079_crc to SIEM is degraded due to physical layer errors on BROKER-A port 1/1 input. 6,960 CRC/alignment errors (0.13% error rate) indicate corrupted frames will be dropped before SIEM analysis, reducing detection coverage.

findings.root_cause: BROKER-A port 1/1 (input) is receiving damaged frames with CRC/alignment errors at 0.001328 (threshold 1e-05) - typically a faulty cable, bad optic/SFP, or duplex/speed mismatch on the link into the packet broker.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM receives incomplete/corrupted traffic; damaged frames are discarded by networking stack, causing missing events/flows and reduced detection coverage even though SIEM does not require full payload or bidirectional traffic.

recommended_fix.why: Physical layer must be clean before any broker policy tuning; replace/reseat cable and optic on BROKER-A 1/1, verify speed/duplex and autoneg settings match far end, clear counters and re-check error rate drops below 1e-05.
